mentions.name: Wayfinder
mentions.description: A Rust-based tool that optimizes LLM agent memory on complex projects by adding a semantic layer on top of an LLM Wiki. It improves agent knowledge over a codebase, cut token usage by 30% in the author's benchmarks, and includes features for handling concurrent agents updating shared memory to keep information reliable and fresh. Published to PyPI (installable via "uv tool install wayfinder-memory") and compatible with almost all agent harnesses.
mentions.problem: Existing approaches to improving agent knowledge over a codebase weren't giving the results the author wanted, and they wanted to keep it simple while optimizing agent memory on complex projects.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on optimizing agent memory on complex projects. That resulted in  this simple Rust-based tool called Wayfinder: https://github.com/zaterka/wayfinder
mentions.author: zaterka
